articles.headline: Everton ponder James Tarkowski alternatives for Merseyside derby with Liverpool
articles.description: Everton manager David Moyes is confident he has the cover to cope with the absence of captain James Tarkowski for the 249th Merseyside derby at home to Liverpool.

articles.headline: Liverpool vs. Everton: Víctor Muñoz doubt, Cody Gakpo out - Andoni Iraola
articles.description: Liverpool forward Víctor Muñoz has avoided a serious knee injury after being forced off in the Reds' 3-0 victory over Club Brugge, however Cody Gakpo remains sidelined for this weekend's Merseyside derby.

articles.headline: Liverpool captain Virgil Van Dijk lauds 'outstanding striker' Alexander Isak
articles.description: Liverpool Virgil van Dijk is expecting "fireworks" during Sunday's Merseyside derby and praised the impact of Alexander Isak and Florain Wirtz.

articles.headline: FA panel details 'obvious error' in Leny Yoro red card against Liverpool
articles.description: Referee Sam Barrott made an "obvious error" in sending off Manchester United defender Leny Yoro against Liverpool, an independent regulatory commission unanimously concluded.

articles.headline: Liverpool are all smiles as Florian Wirtz, Alexander Isak start to click
articles.description: Another match, another fine set of displays from Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak. Is the huge investment in Liverpool's forward line beginning to pay off?

articles.headline: VAR review: Why Man United should've gotten winner vs. Sporting
articles.description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

articles.headline: Andoni Iraola: Alexander Isak in a 'great moment' after brace vs. Club Brugge
articles.description: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola believes striker Alexander Isak is in a "great moment" after he scored twice in the 3-0 victory over Club Brugge.

articles.headline: Iraola 'pleased' to keep clean sheet on top of Liverpool Champions League win
articles.description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola reacts to his side's 0-3 away win against Club Brugge in the Champions League.

articles.headline: Alexander Isak nets brace as Liverpool comfortably beat Club Brugge
articles.description: Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz continued their upward trajectory with the goals in a 3-0 victory over Club Brugge which returned Liverpool to winning ways in the Champions League and got them back on track for a top-eight finish.

articles.headline: Liverpool's Florian Wirtz: Andoni Iraola is bringing me back to my best
articles.description: Florian Wirtz has credited head coach Andoni Iraola with helping him to find his best form for Liverpool in almost two years.

articles.headline: Man United win appeal over Leny Yoro red card
articles.description: Manchester United defender Leny Yoro's one-match suspension has been removed following a successful claim of wrongful dismissal.

articles.headline: Champions League Power Rankings before MD5: Who's No. 1?
articles.description: The UEFA Champions League is going at full speed, and we're beyond the halfway point of the league phase. Injuries are starting to pile up. Where does your club rank?

articles.headline: Man United's heavy Liverpool loss didn't tell us anything new; epic Barça comeback
articles.description: Pochettino's debut as Man United manager didn't tell us anything we didn't already know when it came to the scale of rebuild required.

articles.headline: Man United to appeal Leny Yoro red card against Liverpool - sources
articles.description: Manchester United have notified the Football Association of their intention to appeal Leny Yoro's red card in the 4-0 defeat to Liverpool, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Dominik Szoboszlai labels Liverpool teammate Florian Wirtz 'world-class'
articles.description: Dominik Szoboszlai has dubbed his Liverpool teammate Florian Wirtz "world-class" after his impressive display in Sunday's 4-0 victory over Manchester United.

articles.headline: Rough start for Pochettino at Manchester United
articles.description: Liverpool put four past Manchester United at home as the Red Devils sink to 19th on the table and immediately put Mauricio Pochettino under pressure.

articles.headline: Bruno Fernandes disputes Leny Yoro red card in Liverpool's rout of Man United
articles.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes was not happy with the officiating in Sunday's 4-0 drubbing at Liverpool.

articles.headline: Pochettino: Isak wasn't in control of the ball for Yoro red card
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino reacts to Leny Yoro's red card in Manchester United's 4-0 loss to Liverpool.

articles.headline: Rio Ngumoha: Need to 'stay grounded' despite 'special' goal against Man Utd
articles.description: Rio Ngumoha has described his goal in Liverpool's 4-0 victory over Manchester United as "really special" but said he needs to "stay grounded" amid all of the external attention.

articles.headline: Liverpool 4-0 Man United: Pochettino endures nightmare start - as it happened
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino's United tenure began with humiliation at Anfield, as Liverpool beat their rivals 4-0.
